description: Language-agnostic genre prose & pacing profiles. Pick one id in book_outline.md (Genre Profile); omit or extend as needed.

cyber_legal_thriller.opening: Start with a concrete technical anomaly, breach alert, subpoena, or courtroom contradiction.
cyber_legal_thriller.conflict_engine: Technical evidence constraints + statutory deadlines + asymmetric knowledge between investigator, counsel, and suspect.
cyber_legal_thriller.payoff: Turning raw forensic artifacts (logs, hashes, timestamps) or procedural rules into decisive courtroom leverage.
cyber_legal_thriller.taboos: Never dump statute text or compliance checklists as narrator lectures; embed rules inside stakes and cross-examination.

suspense_rules.opening: Open on an anomalous scene, rule notice, missing person, phone clue, or sudden behavior shift in a close relationship.
suspense_rules.conflict_engine: Limited POV + escalating rule violation cost + character misjudgment.
suspense_rules.payoff: Micro-truths uncovered, misjudgments corrected, or rules exploited to dodge danger—each answer raising a sharper threat.
suspense_rules.taboos: Never reveal answers through narrator exposition; hide clues inside physical actions.

espionage_intel.opening: Enter mid-interrogation, dead-drop handoff, search, document transfer, or traitor tip-off.
espionage_intel.conflict_engine: Mission objective + cover identity exposure risk + asymmetric intel; every op needs time, place, token, and exfil risk.
espionage_intel.payoff: Verifying intel authenticity, preserving cover under pressure, or inducing enemy miscalculation at mortal stakes.
espionage_intel.taboos: Never hand intelligence to the protagonist via omniscient narration.

investigative_mystery.opening: Start with a crime scene, unknown call, reopened cold case, or workplace/police skepticism.
investigative_mystery.conflict_engine: Case deadline + relational/social pressure + information gap shifting trust and safety.
investigative_mystery.payoff: Spotting overlooked details, clearing false suspicion, and forcing peers or authorities to re-evaluate the lead.
investigative_mystery.taboos: Never isolate puzzle-solving from the protagonist's relational stakes.

urban_daily.opening: Enter via a phone message, bill, commute, work snag, or minor family/neighbor friction.
urban_daily.conflict_engine: Concrete everyday problem + acquaintance ties + real financial or social cost.
urban_daily.payoff: Steady, earned improvement in livelihood, trust, or stability through tangible small wins.
urban_daily.taboos: Never open on pure weather/mood prose or escalate slice-of-life into power-fantasy escalation.

workplace_romance.opening: Open on a project crisis, client pitch, office rumor, overtime clash, or promotion/contract constraint.
workplace_romance.conflict_engine: Career deliverables + intimacy boundaries + public professional reputation.
workplace_romance.payoff: Competence recognized publicly, mutual boundary clarity, and turning a stalled project or relationship around.
workplace_romance.taboos: Never write pure project reports devoid of interpersonal tension, or pure romance detached from work stakes.

sci_fi_catastrophe.opening: Start with early collapse signs, supply shortage, shelter gate conflict, betrayal, or system failure alert.
sci_fi_catastrophe.conflict_engine: Scarce resources + trust cost + external existential threat.
sci_fi_catastrophe.payoff: Correct foresight, securing critical infrastructure/supplies, and exploiting hazard rules at real attrition cost.
sci_fi_catastrophe.taboos: Never grant free survival windfalls without new risk or depletion.

historical_intrigue.opening: Enter via court dispute, clan crisis, border dispatch, trial hearing, or sudden appointment/exile.
historical_intrigue.conflict_engine: Institutional hierarchy + status constraints + factional power play.
historical_intrigue.payoff: Public case reversal, turning an opponent's own decree against them, backed by documented proof and proper venue.
historical_intrigue.taboos: Never let the protagonist win purely by modern speechifying; ground moves in period authority.

urban_high_concept.opening: Show a concrete real-world predicament first, then let the anomaly immediately alter it.
urban_high_concept.conflict_engine: Conventional commonsense expectations vs. verifiable anomalous outcomes on bills, contracts, or public feeds.
urban_high_concept.payoff: Bystanders or rivals miscalculating based on normal rules while the anomaly lands on tangible reality.
urban_high_concept.taboos: Never let system panels float in isolation without real-world social or financial impact.

historical_high_concept.opening: Open in a military, court, or clan crisis before introducing the anachronistic tech or info advantage.
historical_high_concept.conflict_engine: Period institutional friction + execution cost + asymmetric knowledge.
historical_high_concept.payoff: Shifting concrete power balances and exploiting institutional loopholes with layered reactions.
historical_high_concept.taboos: Never rely solely on memorized history trivia without logistical cost.

occult_suspense.opening: Start with an unexplained night shift incident, old object, folk rule note, or urgent plea.
occult_suspense.conflict_engine: Unknown phenomenon + occupational compulsion to investigate + rising personal toll.
occult_suspense.payoff: Mapping one more rule boundary, narrowly escaping a cost, or turning an entity's constraint against it.
occult_suspense.taboos: Never let the anomaly explain its own rules on first appearance.

eastern_xianxia.opening: Open on sect discipline, master-disciple tension, trial peril, or cultivation bottleneck.
eastern_xianxia.conflict_engine: Cultivation rules + sect/imperial hierarchy + moral vs. resource trade-offs.
eastern_xianxia.payoff: Breakthrough earned through costly choice, sect backing, and status re-evaluation.
eastern_xianxia.taboos: Never replace character choice and human stakes with bare technique jargon.

western_fantasy.opening: Start with guild commission, temple trial, academy evaluation, or racial/estate friction.
western_fantasy.conflict_engine: Institutional magic/feudal rules + identity limits + casting/contract cost.
western_fantasy.payoff: Reversing formal evaluations, breaking prejudice, or weaponizing contract/magic costs.
western_fantasy.taboos: Never treat fantasy institutions as passive wallpaper; make them constrain choices.

general_fallback.opening: Open in motion with an immediate problem, relationship friction, or concrete stakes.
general_fallback.conflict_engine: Goal + resistance + irreversible cost driving the next scene's expectation.
general_fallback.payoff: Earned shift in leverage, knowledge, or relationship standing.
general_fallback.taboos: Never pad scenes with static mood prose or unmotivated exposition.

esports_competitive.opening: Enter mid-match, live raid, teammate skepticism, talent check, ranking shift, or pre-tactic decision.
esports_competitive.conflict_engine: Clear win condition + tournament/rule constraints + opponent or bystander misjudgment.
esports_competitive.payoff: Executing high-visibility counter-plays backed by visible stats, rankings, or live audience feedback.
esports_competitive.taboos: Never stall with lengthy rule manuals; jump straight into tactical execution.

quick_transmigration.opening: Drop straight into a high-pressure scene—one minute before trial, breakup, or failure warning.
quick_transmigration.conflict_engine: Original plot/role pressure + mission constraints + shifting local character emotions.
quick_transmigration.payoff: Using cross-world experience to rewrite the arc and throw original antagonists off balance.
quick_transmigration.taboos: Never start a new world with long system exposition or let foreknowledge become an effortless win.

ancient_romance_high_concept.opening: Open on an imperial betrothal/annulment, clan interrogation, household rule trap, or identity exposure.
ancient_romance_high_concept.conflict_engine: Period hierarchy/etiquette + protagonist's anomalous edge (transmigration, system, mind-reading) + family politics.
ancient_romance_high_concept.payoff: Turning the anomaly into immediate agency that shifts power inside the household or court.
ancient_romance_high_concept.taboos: Never treat period etiquette as ignorable; the anomaly must work through or against real social rules.

period_slice_of_life.opening: Start with household division, ration/coupon friction, job quota, housing squeeze, or clan slight—showing what the lead lacks.
period_slice_of_life.conflict_engine: Material scarcity + institutional paperwork/quotas + everyday relational debts.
period_slice_of_life.payoff: Earning tangible security, reputation, and independence within the constraints of the era.
period_slice_of_life.taboos: Never dump textbook history; convey the era naturally through objects, forms, and social etiquette.
